gloss: to respect; to honor; to revere

definitions.explanation: To hold someone in high esteem and show deference.
To regard with deep respect, often with religious or spiritual connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget your feelings of respect for your teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}い、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{祈|いの}っている→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: He reveres God and prays every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: An attitude of respecting others is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}っている。
examples.english: The local people revere the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖先|そせん}→祖先：04047_sosen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}い、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We venerate our ancestors and visit their graves every year.

notes:
{敬|うやま}う is transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). It takes を for the person being respected.

ASPECT (ている):
{敬|うやま}っている indicates an ongoing state of respecting someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う (to respect elders)
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う (to respect one's teacher)
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う (to revere God)
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬|うやま}う: The person being respected

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{尊敬|そんけい}する→尊敬する：01454_sonkei⟧: To respect (more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{敬意|けいい}→敬意：02781_keii⟧: Respect (noun)
- ⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧: Honorific language

Register: Somewhat formal/literary. ⟦{尊敬|そんけい}する→尊敬する：01454_sonkei⟧ is more commonly used in everyday conversation. {敬|うやま}う has a more traditional, reverent nuance.
